{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOLEgSIs8AAAABZhbVUQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bm7fazhDIa2U", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bm7fa", "number": 49, "title": "Correct individual pose queries, view snapshots and viewport bindings", "body": "## Problem

At `baf056097b1a366a61927e75666473ce44793ba9`, `geometry.ts` hardcodes every XRPose's `emulatedPosition` to true, omits `XRView.index`, and implements readonly attributes as writable JavaScript fields. Projection arrays remain detached after transfer. `runtime.ts` checks frame activity before argument conversion and uses realm-local `instanceof` for viewer reference spaces. `layers.ts` similarly uses realm-local view checks and returns a new viewport on every call.

Applications can receive misleading pose metadata, reject genuine cross-realm values, overwrite exposed state or lose projection data. These defects remain after #47/#48.

## Expected outcome

Complete the existing individual pose-to-rendering contract for Quest VR, Quest MR and Android AR, including viewer-only inline sessions. Preserve current rendering, transform navigation and shutdown behavior. This adds no feature descriptor and does not complete unrelated deferred modules.

## Context

Target `dev`. Relevant implementation: `src/polyfill/api/{geometry,runtime,interface-brand,layers,sensing}.ts`, `CustomWebXRPolyfill.ts`, and geometric allocation call sites.

Contracts: [Device CRD, 9 June 2026, §§5–9 and 11.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webxr-20260609/), [WebIDL 622910c](https://github.com/whatwg/webidl/blob/622910c67c724e362f71e8255a0380bade261acb/index.bs), and [Layers WD, 11 August 2026](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/WD-webxrlayers-1-20260811/). [WPT e185958](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/tree/e1859580b5fcf74940a18d2f783296b4961035e3/webxr) supplies applicable pose, identity, lifetime and optional-scaling assertions. Adapt native fake-device setup explicitly; inspect assertions against the fixed baseline before adopting them.

The [#47 execution record](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/blob/baf056097b1a366a61927e75666473ce44793ba9/docs/webxr-rigid-transform-validation-2026-10-24.json) reports transform/navigation and reference/shutdown passes on Chromium 156.0.8078.4 and Firefox 157.0. It does not establish these new cases. The standalone WPT runner currently selects five other files.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Implement branded, enumerable/configurable readonly prototype accessors for XRFrame's `session`/`predictedDisplayTime`, XRPose's four attributes, XRViewerPose's `views`, XRView's declared attributes and XRViewport's coordinates/dimensions. Preserve SameObject identities and frozen views arrays. Reject prototype forgeries, proxies and wrong receivers. Enforce nonconstructible public interfaces and implement XRViewGeometry as a mixin rather than an extra public interface/prototype.

- [ ] For `getPose` and `getViewerPose`, validate receiver, required arguments and interface types before method-state checks. Binding failures throw TypeError synchronously; valid arguments on inactive frames or from foreign sessions throw InvalidStateError. Event frames permit getPose and reject getViewerPose. Validate both spaces before a tracking-null shortcut. Test genuine separately injected iframe/popup values and borrowed methods in both directions.

- [ ] Populate `emulatedPosition` from the relative tracking relationship: known virtual 6DoF relationships, including self-relative poses, report false; estimated positions report true when supplied. Unsupported velocities remain null. Exercise existing unavailable-tracking transitions without inventing physical-sensor fidelity. Preserve relative geometry and individual/bulk agreement.

- [ ] Allocate getPose results in the frame's realm, and viewer poses/views/transforms in the session's realm. Supply consecutive `XRView.index` values. Retained result attributes remain readable after callbacks/end; subsequent queries remain lifetime-checked. Test fresh query results separately from per-object identity guarantees.

- [ ] Cache attached projection arrays; regenerate detached arrays from independent projection data in the view's realm. Keep array elements mutable. Writes/transfers must not corrupt subsequent projection calculations, other snapshots or compositor calibration. Preserve existing transform matrix guarantees.

- [ ] Correct getViewport receiver/argument brands, current-animation-frame ownership and cached viewport identity. Reject stale/foreign views with InvalidStateError. Correct requestViewportScale's required nullable-double conversion, including coercion exceptions and nonfinite rejection. Fixed-resolution no-op behavior and null recommendations may remain; add no unsupported capability claim or invented stale-view gate to that method.

- [ ] Update affected internal allocation and rendering consumers together. Exercise base-layer and existing projection-layer paths, including same-origin borrowed view consumers, and preserve shared geometry used by CPU depth and joint poses. Projection rendering requires no `layers` request. Keep existing feature/profile restrictions explicit; broader sensing/layer expansion remains separate work.

- [ ] Extend the existing Chromium/Firefox focused harness in `tests/reference-space-browser.ts` with a bounded pose/view selection and document its exact invocation. The Coordinator executes it across all six immersive profile/browser combinations and inline on both device profiles. Record rendered mono/stereo pixels before/after projection transfer, navigation, restart, cleanup, adaptations, instrumentation, versions and tested hashes. Execute `npm run build:firefox` and `git diff --check`; inspect generated changes. Report failures, skips and unperformed checks separately from passing results. No generic application-suite rerun is required.

- [ ] Update the versioned inventory and evidence documentation. If primary evidence reveals a mistaken AI requirement, retain the original assumption, correction, pinned source and rationale in the Issue/PR without human approval or independent AI re-review. Preserve the goal and meaningful acceptance. Implementation, tests and normal PR review remain Coordinator-owned.

## Optional validation

Execute the unchanged Three.js r186 teleport example at commit `9b4a2ac29c63ccb43fd51c5661f2f873ac2c39b8` as an additional navigation consumer. Record actual application and dependency provenance; source inspection alone earns no execution credit.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WebXR API compatibility goal for
Quest 3 VR/MR and Android AR. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
